HS flags (6): rxvalidhs_x, rxactivehs_x, rxsynchs_x, errsoths_x, errsotsynchs_x, rxskewcalhs_x.
LP flags (9): stopstate_x, rxulpsesc_x, erresc_x, errcontrol_x, ulpsactivenot_x, rxtriggeresc_x [3:0].
HS flags on pins encoded in 3 bits: 6 legal combinations and 1 code for any other. Over SPI: as option 1, with erresc_x and errcontrol_x as counters.
